principles: Authorization and field filtering occur before serialization and before search results, counts, totals, container aggregates, history, provenance, comparison, suggestions, or AI context are computed.

Reusable Item Definition, Definition variant/configuration, Asset Instance, authority relations, containment, equipment assignment, mutable runtime state, knowledge state, and transaction history remain distinguishable.
Unknown, source-unspecified, not-applicable, zero, empty, depleted, destroyed, and hidden are different states and must never be collapsed.
Ownership, custody, possession, control, access, and equipment are independent relationships; no one relationship silently grants another.
Source facts, source-limited fields, owner-delegated recommendations, conflicts, and reference-only names remain visibly and semantically distinct.
Every spatial or drag-oriented inventory operation has an equivalent keyboard, touch, screen-reader, and nonvisual command path.

visibility_classes.meaning: Definition fields the subject may inspect through current content/pack/entitlement/permission policy.
Asset Instance existence and current state the subject is authorized to know.
Character/controller-private loadout planning or owned state not automatically visible to unrelated roles.
Campaign-local Asset information explicitly revealed to the subject.
Hidden loot, unidentified truth, secret contents, reserve Assets, private prices/rewards, or GM preparation state.
Private trade/offer/reservation/history details visible only to authorized parties and governing GM/admin roles.
Source coordinates, inferred/recommended status, conflict state, validation, coverage, and provenance when separately authorized.
User-private notes or drafts that are not granted by GM/Admin status alone.

field_groups.identity_rule: Display name, filename, source name, and reference-only name never replace stable Definition identity.

field_groups.relationship_rule: Ownership, custody, possession, control, access, and usage permission are independent.

field_groups.privacy_rule: Hidden contents are filtered before child counts, totals, weight/value aggregates, capacity summaries, previews, search, exports, or AI context.

field_groups.lineage_rule: Split and merge preserve lot lineage; visually identical items are not automatically stack-compatible.

field_groups.authority_rule: Equip/install/attune never silently changes ownership or custody.

field_groups.unknown_rule: Source-unspecified maximum capacity is represented as unknown/source-unspecified, never zero, unlimited, or inferred merely for UI completeness.

field_groups.lifecycle_rule: Zero durability does not universally delete an Asset; repair/destruction preserve attributable history.

field_groups.truth_rule: Knowledge projection never overwrites authoritative truth; hidden truth is omitted before serialization.

field_groups.transaction_rule: Displayed price or offer is not an accepted transfer; each authority relation change is explicit.

field_groups.atomicity_rule: Inputs are not consumed and outputs are not created until the owning work order commits atomically.

field_groups.navigation_rule: Every target is reauthorized before traversal; same-name similarity never authorizes identity merge.

field_groups.source_truth_rule: Source fact, recommendation, source-unspecified field, conflict, and reference-only record must remain distinguishable.

field_groups.recovery_rule: Ambiguous network outcomes use status lookup with the same operation ID before retry; reconnect restores current authorized state rather than replaying client assumptions.

player.rule: Container existence, child counts, value/weight totals, unidentified truth, hidden loot, secret prices, and provenance diagnostics are omitted when unauthorized rather than redacted after delivery.

gm.rule: GM can manage authorized Campaign Asset truth but does not gain unrelated Player-private notes or other-Campaign data.

assistant_gm.rule: Projection is computed from explicit delegation scope, Campaign scope, field/action scope, and expiry; deny by default outside the delegation.

creator_owner_admin.rule: Campaign instance, transaction, or user-private fields require separate Campaign/user authority despite administrative role.

service_ai.rule: Minimum operation-specific projection after authorization; AI may summarize or draft a proposal only and may not infer hidden inventory, transfer/consume/create/destroy Assets, or promote source recommendations.

preconditions: authorize exact target and requested layer

action_contracts.result: new Asset Instance plus provenance-bearing event

must_not: leak hidden children through aggregate changes
merge incompatible or hidden ownership states
copy Definition mechanics into Character source record

action_contracts.result: atomic accepted usage and cost/consumption event
accepted transfer receipt and updated authority relations
must_not: repeat transfer after ambiguous response without status lookup

action_contracts.result: future projections include newly authorized knowledge
atomic input transformation/output lineage when work order commits
must_not: create outputs on failed/cancelled work order
expose hidden contents via totals or diagnostics

expanded_large: container tree with synchronized nonvisual list
medium: single primary list with detail drawer/sheet
keyboard: all drag/drop operations have move-to/equip/store commands
batch selection exposes count and scope text
screen_reader: container hierarchy uses semantic tree/list alternative
high_zoom_reflow: core action/status remains available at 200%+ text
no horizontal scroll required for essential state
reduced_motion: no animation required to understand transfer/equip/consume/reveal results

acceptance_invariants: Unauthorized roles cannot infer hidden Asset existence, child counts, stack quantities, total weight/value, container occupancy, loot, reservations, or history through any projection or aggregate.
Definition identity and Asset Instance identity remain visible as distinct concepts whenever both are shown.
Ownership, custody, possession, control, access, location, containment, and equipment assignment are never collapsed into one field.
Unknown/source-unspecified capacity is never rendered or persisted as zero, unlimited, empty, or fabricated capacity.
Reference-only Energy Sniper Rifle, Plasma Carbine, and Cryo Blaster entries cannot be selected as complete weapon Definitions unless a governed Definition is later created.
The two published Taser contexts remain independently inspectable and comparable with provenance; same-name auto-merge is forbidden.
A failed-before-commit use/reload/consume/transfer/craft operation changes no authoritative inventory state.
Retry after ambiguous network failure uses the same operation ID and command-status lookup so accepted effects cannot occur twice.
Split, merge, transfer, repair, craft, salvage, and destruction preserve attributable lineage/history.
Every item action usable by drag-and-drop also has an equivalent keyboard/touch/nonvisual command path.
